title: D-Zone Dice
description: Defenders return to the defensive zone, stop in assigned positions, then defend a scripted offensive action before the drill becomes live.
coaching_points: Establish the defensive-zone structure before play becomes live.
Recognize the scripted offensive trigger and execute the team coverage.
Stay connected to the structure after the puck moves and the rep becomes competitive.

title: Alberni Valley Power Play Game
description: A possession-based special-teams entry game where the power play uses support and numerical advantage to enter against penalty-kill pressure and wedge organization.
coaching_points: Give the puck carrier multiple support options on the entry.
Use the numerical advantage instead of forcing an isolated attack.
Penalty killers keep sticks in lanes and organize into the chosen pressure shape.
author: Matt Thomas

title: Battle Creek 2 on 2
description: Starts with a corner possession battle, progresses through D activation and transition, then finishes with defensemen regapping through the middle to defend a 2-on-2 rush.
coaching_points: Escape the battle with possession and move above the goal line.
Forwards provide clear outlets during the transition.
Defensemen recover through the middle and regap together.
author: Matt Thomas

title: 3 v 2 Backside Ice Balance
description: A 3-on-2 offensive-zone game that teaches players to identify puck carrier, support, and backside roles while rotating as the puck changes sides.
coaching_points: Keep a weak-side player available as the backside option.
Rotate responsibilities as the puck moves from side to side.
Maintain support away from the puck instead of collapsing into one area.

title: 1 v 2 with Backside Presence
description: Two players work together on a board-side puck recovery, then immediately move the puck to a weak-side backside player for the offensive opportunity.
coaching_points: Pressure and support the recovery together instead of independently.
Look to the backside as soon as possession is won.
Turn the recovery into offense by using the weak-side space quickly.

title: Skate Touch Warm Up
description: A circle-based warm-up where every player must use a skate as the first touch before transitioning into the next offensive action and creating a shot.
coaching_points: Make the first touch intentionally with the skate.
Use different feet and angles depending on the incoming puck.
Transition quickly from the skate touch into an offensive play.

title: 3 v 2 Improve the Advantage
description: A neutral-zone 3-on-2 game where the offense must improve its existing numerical advantage by creating extra speed, space, positioning, or access behind defenders.
coaching_points: Do more than simply recognize the 3-on-2; improve the advantage.
Create speed differentials away from the puck.
Manipulate defenders with routes and attack space behind them.

title: 3 v 3 Using the Weak Side for Possession
description: A possession game that uses a weak-side player to spread defenders, relieve pressure, and create the next passing option away from congestion.
coaching_points: Use the full width of the available space.
Find the weak-side option when pressure collapses around the puck.
Keep off-puck movement purposeful and manage possession patiently.
